title: Karl the Janitor
text: I saw lights in the mayor's office at 3 AM. Every. Single. Night.

tutorial.hintText: This witness seems reliable. → INVESTIGATE to add evidence to your board.

title: Blurry City Hall Photo
text: Someone emailed this in. Lights at 3:17 AM. Very blurry. Very suspicious.

tutorial.hintText: A blurry anonymous photo? Doesn't pass the smell test. ← IGNORE it.

title: Pizza Delivery Receipt
text: Delivered to City Hall at 3:45 AM. Three large pepperoni pizzas. Who eats that much at 3 AM?

tutorial.hintText: Sometimes you need a story fast. ↑ FAKE is quick but wrecks your credibility.

title: Rival Paper Scoop
text: The Daily Chronicle just published a puff piece on the Mayor's new golf swing. We need cash to keep the lights on.

tutorial.hintText: Too much heat? ↓ LEAK tips off a rival paper — cools the heat, costs credibility.
